summary: E-commerce project with product management fixes and UI color updates needed.
known_issues: Product management: uploading new products and editing existing products is broken

existing_features.title: Fix the 'Add Product' flow in the ProductManagement admin component so that submitting the add-product dialog successfully calls the backend addProduct mutation, persists the new product, and refreshes the product list without errors.

Fix the 'Edit Product' flow in the ProductManagement admin component so that opening an existing product in the edit dialog pre-populates all fields correctly, submitting calls the backend updateProduct mutation, and the product list reflects the saved changes.

Change every button across the entire frontend (public-facing pages including Hero CTAs, ProductGrid, Header, Footer, SocialProof, TrustBadges) and the Admin Panel (AdminLogin, AdminPanel, ProductManagement dialogs, and all tab/action buttons) to use the hot-pink color defined in the Tailwind config (the 'hot-pink' palette token). Remove any remaining non-pink primary button styles and ensure consistency.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix product management: unable to upload new product or edit existing products
Change all button colors to pink across frontend and Admin Panel backend
